caption: The drawing is vertically divided into two main sections within a rectangular frame. The upper section depicts two human figures with halos and crowns, one larger and one smaller, seated together. The larger figure, possibly female, has long brown hair, wears a blue and white cloak with a red dress underneath, and holds an object in her left hand while her right arm supports the smaller figure. The smaller figure, who appears to be a child, is sitting on the lap of the larger figure, is partially unclothed with a crown on their head, and holds a green object. Behind both figures is a yellow and brown arched background with a jagged red border, and the bottom edge shows wavy cloud-like shapes. The lower section of the composition features a symmetrical, abstract design resembling a stylized plant or flower with red, brown, black, pink, teal, and green shapes radiating outward from a central teal base against a pale yellow background. The borders throughout are black lines, and the number "7" appears in the lower left corner outside the main frame.
title: Plate 7: Our Lady of Mt. Carmel: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
